content:
Luis (Docs): Quick sync: we need a short, friendly migration note for customers who hit a v1->v2 model swap unexpectedly. Goal: reduce support tickets and provide clear rollback steps.
Priya (SDK): I can add a CompatShim snippet for the most common v1 callsites. will drop a minimal example below.
Mark (DevEx): also planning to auto-run snippet smoke tests on merge. suggest adding a `compat/` folder in samples for easy discovery.
Zoe (Product): let's be explicit about billing differences (per-token vs per-response) and how batching can change cost profiles. Carmen, will Support be happy with that level of detail?
Carmen (Support): yes, but keep the public doc simple. we'll have an internal KB with the deeper billing math and regression triage checklist.
Priya (SDK): Compat shim draft (Python):
```python
# compat shim to map v1 generate(...) -> v2 responses.create(...)
def generate_compat(client, model, prompt, **kwargs):
    # naive shim: translate params and call v2 API
    return client.responses.create(model=model.replace('legacy', '2.0'), input=prompt, **kwargs)
```
Luis (Docs): great. can you also give a small JS example for streaming fallback? we should show both sync and stream.
Priya (SDK): sure.
```js
// shim for basic streaming behavior
async function streamCompat(client, opts) {
  for await (const ev of client.responses.stream(opts)) {
    if (ev.type === 'delta') process.stdout.write(ev.delta);
  }
}
```
Mark (DevEx): file layout for PR: `docs/migration/v1-to-v2.md`, `samples/compat/*`, `internal/support/migration-cheatsheet.md`. I can open the docs PR today.
Luis (Docs): assign me as reviewer for docs wording. Priya -> SDK PR for README + compat module. Carmen -> I'll link the internal KB in the PR description.
Zoe (Product): timeline? we want the public migration notice to go live before we start flipping aliases in staging. Two days min.
Carmen (Support): need 48h to draft canned replies and update our triage playbook.
Priya (SDK): question on error codes: v2 returns new error code `MODEL_ALIAS_DEPRECATED` when an alias is removed. should docs call it out or leave for SDK error mapping?
Luis (Docs): call it out in the FAQ with suggested fix steps (pin to model version, or use alias map). Put the exact error string so support can search logs.
Mark (DevEx): ci-bot: please trigger linkcheck and snippet-runner on branch `migration/compat-shim` when PRs are opened.
ci-bot: scheduled: linkcheck, snippet-runner, smoke-test (samples) on branch migration/compat-shim. ETA 5m.
Priya (SDK): one more thing: embed vector dims may change for some models post-swap. we need a note on client-side index compatibility and suggested migration path (reindexing).
Luis (Docs): include a short paragraph: "If your vector index expects X dims and the model returns Y, reindexing is required. See internal reindex playbook." Carmen, add a support blurb for customers on reindex timing windows.
Carmen (Support): will do. also prepping a short script to detect dimension mismatches in customer's telemetry.
Zoe (Product): logging/observability: ensure we add a dashboard tile showing errors with `MODEL_ALIAS_DEPRECATED` and a spike detector for embed-dim mismatches. Noah (Eng) can pair with Mark if needed.
Mark (DevEx): noted. I'll add dashboard tickets and link them in the PR checklist.
Luis (Docs): final deliverables and owners: docs migration page (Luis), samples/compat (Mark+Priya), SDK compat module & README (Priya), internal KB & canned replies (Carmen), dashboards (Mark). Aim to merge in 48h, go-live notice 24h after merge.
Priya (SDK): will include unit tests for the shim and special-case mapping for streaming shapes.
Mark (DevEx): opening PRs now. Will tag owners and add smoke-test prompts.
Luis (Docs): smoke-test prompts we should include in PR: short summary, json-output, embed vector length check. Priya, can you add expected outputs in test fixtures?
Priya (SDK): yes. I'll add fixtures for both legacy and v2 output shapes.
ci-bot: CI checks passed on branch migration/compat-shim (lint ✔, snippet-runner ✔, linkcheck ✔, smoke-test ✔).
Carmen (Support): thanks everyone — I'll schedule a 30m run-through with Support and Docs after merge.
Luis (Docs): perfect. If anything unexpected shows up during the staging alias flip, tag #incidents and we'll escalate. Thanks! :rocket:
